description: A free-DOF tangent stiffness matrix and right-hand side (the free-DOF external load) dumped at a cracked, converged state of a parity model (plan §4 H), with boundary conditions eliminated exactly (no TS penalty) so Carapace's exact supports apply directly. faer's LU should solve A x = rhs with relative residual < 1e-10; maxAsymmetry confirms the matrix is genuinely nonsymmetric (kc2 coupling), so it must route to LU and not Cholesky.
